title: OpenAI Cybersecurity Grant Program
summary: Our goal is to facilitate the development of AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities for defenders through grants and other support.
body: Our goal is to facilitate the development of AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities for defenders through grants and other support.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布推出网络安全资助计划，旨在通过资金支持和其他资源，促进防御者开发基于AI的网络安全能力。原始信息显示：Our goal is to facilitate the development of AI-powered cybersecurity capabilities for defenders through grants and other support.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“OpenAI Cybersecurity Grant Program”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出网络安全资助计划，推动AI技术在防御性网络安全领域的实际应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
